summary: Ephemeral debug role session-tag truncation causing KMS/S3 denies in eu-west envs
description:
Issue summary:
Ephemeral debug/service operator role sessions originating from the access-broker in eu-west are intermittently missing full session tag payloads. When tags are truncated, org-level IAM condition policies deny KMS Encrypt and S3 PutObject for the ml-deploy-runner/ephemeral sa, causing private-deploy debug and bootstrap workflows to fail.

Impact:
- Several private/preprod debug jobs and a small percentage (~3%) of dedicated onboarding runs in eu-west are failing with AccessDenied for kms:Encrypt and s3:PutObject.
- Customers on dedicated/proxy debug paths unaffected externally, but internal debugging and scaling tests are impacted.
- Increase in SEV1 escalations from SRE when ephemeral runs fail during preflight checks.

Environment:
- Affected: prod accounts in eu-west region (eu-west-1), access-broker v1.9.3, auth-proxy v2.4.
- Observed during automated onboarding and manual JIT debug flows that assume cross-account STS roles from GCP WIF / AWS broker.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Trigger ephemeral bootstrap via ops tooling: ./ops/bootstrap --env=eu-west --job=ephemeral-debug --service=ml-deploy-runner
2) Observe broker logs for STS AssumeRole call and returned SessionTags payload.
3) Reproduce via aws sts assume-role with generated session tags header (simulate long tag set).
4) Check KMS/S3 access with aws kms encrypt and aws s3 cp; failures correlate with truncated session tag string length > 256 chars.

Observed behavior / Logs:
- access-broker logs (trace id ab12f3): "session_tags length 256 -> truncated" recorded in v1.9.3.
- AWS CloudTrail shows AssumeRole success but RequestParameters.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName absent when tags truncated.
- KMS denies: "User: arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/ephemeral-debug-role/Sess is not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on resource" with condition failure on StringEquals tag:team.
- S3 PutObject denies with similar tag condition failures.

Investigation notes:
- Hypothesis: tag serialization in the broker is not consistent across the GCP->AWS translation path; long metadata + multiple tag keys exceed allowed header lengths, causing silent truncation by the broker or by STS session encoding.
- Reproduced locally by constructing a tag payload > 260 bytes; AWS STS accepts call but resulting sessionContext truncates some keys.
- auth-proxy v2.4 introduced extra identity attributes (workspace_id, deploy_hash) which increased average tag payload size from ~120 bytes to ~320 bytes.
- Related historical tickets indicate similar symptoms but not identical: linked INT-100200 addressed tag normalization in a different broker service.

Workarounds tried:
- Short-term: added a temp condition exception for the ephemeral-debug-role resource in eu-west (resource-based allow) to unblock immediate bootstraps. Applied on 2026-03-11 at 03:20 UTC.
- Short-term alternate: trim optional tag keys at the caller side (ops shim) before calling assume-role; this reduces tracing fidelity.

Proposed resolution / next steps:
1) Priority bugfix: normalize tag serialization inside access-broker to deterministic compact encoding (key hashing + allowlist) and prevent truncation (owner: infra-team). Target: ship v1.9.4 to staging by 2026-03-15 and prod rollout 2026-03-18.
2) Add unit/integration tests that simulate long session tag payloads and assert no IAM condition denials.
3) Revert resource-based allow once v1.9.4 is live and verified.
4) Post-deploy: run a targeted soak in eu-west with 1k ephemeral bootstraps to validate.
5) Follow-up task: document tag size limits in cloud-access-runbook and update ops shim to enforce tag allowlist.

Risk and rollback plan:
- Rolling back v1.9.4 is low-risk (broker change only) but will require coordination with SRE to revert ephemeral allowlist.
- If issue persists after fix, escalate to security for potential policy adjustments.

Resolution notes (in progress):
- Temporary allowlist applied on 2026-03-11 to restore service.
- Patch PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4212 (access-broker: compact-tag-encoding).
- Deployment plan drafted and stuckpoint is adding integration test harness for STS session encoding.

2026-03-11 | Priya Singh (SRE) | Requested that we add metrics for session tag sizes to broker logs and a dashboard to surface this for 24h post-deploy.
2026-03-12 | Marcus Chen | Added integration test plan and scheduled staging rollout for 2026-03-15. Noted need for runbook update after fix.
